facts.statement: Nipponosaurus was a lambeosaurine duck-billed dinosaur found in sediments on the island of Sakhalin.
facts.quote: Nipponosaurus (meaning "Japanese lizard") is a lambeosaurine hadrosaur from sediments of the Yezo Group, in Sinegorsk on the island of Sakhalin

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was discovered in November 1934 during the construction of a hospital for a mining company in what is now Sakhalin, Russia.
facts.quote: The holotype (UHR 6590, University of Hokkaidō Registration) was discovered in November 1934 during the construction of a hospital for the Kawakami colliery of the Mitsui Mining Company on Karafuto Prefecture

facts.statement: A second expedition in 1937 recovered additional limb material belonging to the holotype specimen.
facts.quote: A second expedition was organised in the summer of 1937, in which limb material pertaining to the holotype was recovered

facts.statement: Based on associated molluscs, Nipponosaurus likely lived around 80 million years ago during the upper Santonian or lower Campanian.
facts.quote: Dating the only specimen has been difficult, but based on associated mollusc taxa, the species likely lived sometime in the upper Santonian or lower Campanian, around 80 million years ago

facts.statement: The immature holotype specimen of Nipponosaurus measures approximately 4 meters in length.
facts.quote: The immature holotype specimen measures roughly 4 m in length

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton of Nipponosaurus is estimated to be 60% complete.
facts.quote: the holotype skeleton is estimated to be 60% complete

facts.statement: The sedimentary context suggests Nipponosaurus was buried in a marine setting near the shore.
facts.quote: Based on the sediments it was preserved in, the Nipponosaurus specimen is thought to have been buried in a marine setting

facts.statement: The validity of Nipponosaurus has been debated, with some researchers suggesting it is a nomen dubium or synonymous with other Asian hadrosaurs.
facts.quote: Since then, the taxon has been largely ignored, and its validity has been doubted, with synonymy with other Asian hadrosaurs or status as a nomen dubium being suggested

facts.statement: Some authors consider Nipponosaurus a nomen dubium due to questionable diagnostic characteristics and its immature status.
facts.quote: Some authors have deemed the species a nomen dubium, questioning its supposed diagnostic characteristics, especially in light of its presumed immature status

facts.statement: Recent analyses suggest Nipponosaurus may be closely related to European taxa like Arenysaurus and Blasisaurus rather than North American lambeosaurines.
facts.quote: More recently, another analysis, accounting for characters that vary through ontogeny, instead found it to be closely related to the European taxa Arenysaurus and Blasisaurus, outside of Lambeosaurini

facts.statement: Nipponosaurus was originally classified in Trachodontidae but is now placed in Hadrosauridae.
facts.quote: Nipponosaurus was described as a member of the Trachodontidae; however Trachodon is now considered an invalid nomen dubium. The family is now known as the Hadrosauridae

facts.statement: A 2004 cladistic analysis placed Nipponosaurus close to Hypacrosaurus altispinus within the Lambeosaurinae.
facts.quote: A cladistic analysis in 2004 placed Nipponosaurus sachalinensis very close to the well-known North American Hypacrosaurus altispinus within the Lambeosaurinae

facts.statement: The species was discovered in 1934 and named in 1936 by Takumi Nagao.
facts.quote: Conocida solo por un solo espécimen juvenil descubierto en 1934 y nombrado en 1936 por Takumi Nagao

facts.statement: Additional material belonging to the same individual was found in 1937.
facts.quote: Con más material del mismo individuo encontrado en 1937

facts.statement: The animal lived during the late Cretaceous period, approximately 85 to 80 million years ago, between the Santonian and Campanian stages.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 85 a 80 millones de años entre el Santoniense y el Campaniense

facts.statement: It lived in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: en lo que hoy es Asia

facts.statement: The holotype was discovered in November 1934 during the construction of a hospital for the Kawakami mine in the Karafuto Prefecture, now Sinegorsk, Sakhalin, Russia.
facts.quote: se descubrió en noviembre de 1934 durante la construcción de un hospital para la mina de Kawakami de la Compañía Minera Mitsui en la Prefectura de Karafuto, ahora Sinegorsk, Sajalín, Rusia

facts.statement: The generic name refers to Nippon, the Japanese name for Japan, and it was the first dinosaur named based on a find in Japanese territory.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se refiere a Nippon, el nombre japonés de Japón, fue el primer dinosaurio nombrado con base en un hallazgo realizado en territorio japonés

facts.statement: The specific name refers to Sakhalin.
facts.quote: El nombre específico se refiere a Sajalín

facts.statement: The immature holotype specimen measures approximately 4 meters in length.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo inmaduro mide aproximadamente 4 metros de longitud

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton is estimated to be 60% complete.
facts.quote: se estima que el esqueleto holotipo está completo en un 60%

facts.statement: The skeleton includes a left maxilla and dentary, parietal, various isolated skull elements, thirteen cervical vertebrae, six dorsal vertebrae, two sacral vertebrae, and a series of 35 caudal vertebrae.
facts.quote: Consiste en un maxilar izquierdo y dentario , parietal , varios elementos del cráneo aislados, trece vértebras cervicales, seis vértebras dorsales, dos vértebras sacras, una serie de 35 vértebras caudales

facts.statement: It also includes a left scapula, lower portions of both humeri, most of the lower forelimb elements, an ischium, the left ilium, and most of the hindlimbs.
facts.quote: una escápula izquierda, porciones inferiores de ambos húmero, la mayoría de los elementos de las extremidades anteriores inferiores, un isquion, el ilion izquierdo y la mayoría de las extremidades posteriores

facts.statement: Based on associated mollusk taxa, the species likely lived sometime in the upper Santonian or lower Campanian.
facts.quote: con base en los taxones de moluscos asociados, la especie probablemente vivió en algún momento en el Santoniense superior o en el Campaniense inferior

facts.statement: Its validity has been questioned, with suggestions of synonymy with other Asian hadrosaurs or status as a nomen dubium.
facts.quote: su validez ha sido puesta en duda, con sinonimia con otros hadrosaurios asiáticos o siendo sugerido estatus como nomen dubium

facts.statement: Some authors have considered the species doubtful, questioning its supposed diagnostic characters, especially in light of its presumed immature state.
facts.quote: Algunos autores han considerado a la especie como dudosa, cuestionando sus supuestas características de diagnóstico, especialmente a la luz de su presunto estado inmaduro

facts.statement: It was originally described as a member of Trachodontidae, but since Trachodon is now considered an invalid nomen dubium, the family is known as Hadrosauridae.
facts.quote: Nipponosaurus fue descrito como un miembro de Trachodontidae. Sin embargo, Trachodon ahora se considera un nomen dubium no válido. La familia ahora se conoce como Hadrosauridae

facts.statement: Nagao thought it was possibly closest to the taxa Cheneosaurus and Tetragonosaurus.
facts.quote: Nagao pensó que posiblemente era el más cercano a los taxones Cheneosaurus y Tetragonosaurus

facts.statement: A 2004 cladistic analysis placed Nipponosaurus sachalinensis very close to the North American Hypacrosaurus altispinus within Lambeosaurinae.
facts.quote: Un análisis cladístico en 2004 colocó a Nipponosaurus sachalinensis muy cerca del conocido Hypacrosaurus altispinus de Norteamérica dentro de Lambeosaurinae

facts.statement: In 2007, a study reevaluating a character related to the distal ischial foot size found that this moved Nipponosaurus away from H. altispinus to a more basal position within Corythosaurini.
facts.quote: más adelante en 2007, un estudio que proporcionó una redescripción de Lambeosaurus magnicristatus revaluó un personaje relacionado con el tamaño del pie isquial distal, y descubrió que esto alejó a Nipponosaurus de H. altispinus y en una posición más basal dentro de su Corythosaurini

facts.statement: Another analysis found that it is closely related to the European taxa Arenysaurus and Blasisaurus, outside of Lambeosaurini.
facts.quote: otro análisis, que explica los caracteres que varían según la ontogenia, encontró que está estrechamente relacionado con los taxones europeos Arenysaurus y Blasisaurus, fuera de Lambeosaurini

facts.statement: The final margin of the coronoid process overlaps with the posterior part of the dental battery, which was suggested to perhaps reflect a difference in feeding habits compared to other taxa.
facts.quote: el margen final del proceso coronoide se superpone con la parte posterior de la batería dental, que se sugirió para reflejar quizás una diferencia en los hábitos alimenticios de otros taxones

facts.statement: The specimen was collected from the upper Yezo Group, which was known as the upper ammonite bed at the time of the original description.
facts.quote: El espécimen se recolectó del grupo Yezo superior, que se conocía como el lecho de amonites superiores en el momento de la descripción original.

facts.statement: Nagao noted that fossil mollusks now called Parapuzosia japonica and Sphenoceramus schmidti were found at the locality, and they are known to come from the lower Campanian.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, Nagao observó que los moluscos fósiles ahora llamados Parapuzosia japonica y Sphenoceramus schmidti también se encontraron en la localidad, y se sabe que provienen del Campaniense inferior.

facts.statement: Therefore, an age from the upper Santonian to the lower Campanian is probable.
facts.quote: Por lo tanto, es probable una edad desde el Santoniense superior al Campaniense inferior.

facts.statement: According to the sediments in which it was preserved, it is believed that the Nipponosaurus specimen was buried in a marine environment.
facts.quote: Según los sedimentos en los que se conservó, se cree que el espécimen de Nipponosaurus fue enterrado en un entorno marino.

facts.statement: This indicates that the species may have lived mainly on low plains near the coast, a lifestyle consistent with some of its North American relatives.
facts.quote: Esto indica que la especie pudo haber vivido principalmente en llanuras bajas cerca de la costa, un estilo de vida consistente con algunos de sus parientes norteamericanos.

facts.statement: Its parent group is Lambeosaurinae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Lambeosaurinae

facts.statement: It belongs to the family Hadrosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Hadrosauridae

facts.statement: It is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: It lived from the Santonian to the Campanian, between 85.7 and 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Campanian (85.7 to 72.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The only known species, N. sachalinensis, is known from a single juvenile specimen discovered in 1934 and named in 1936 by Takumi Nagao.
rejected.quote: The type and only species is N. sachalinensis, known only from a single juvenile specimen discovered in 1934 and named in 1936, by Takumi Nagao
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'from a single juvenile specimen discovered in 1934'

rejected.statement: Evidence suggests Nipponosaurus lived primarily on low-lying plains near the coast.
rejected.quote: This indicates the species may have lived primarily on low-lying plains near the coast
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'lived primarily on low-lying plains near the coast'
